_note: Plain gameplay numbers, read by both editions (web: packed into textures.js by build-textures.ps1; desktop: res://data/numbers.json). Names are the web version's constant names. Materials: crude, stone, copper, iron, bronite, rosium, steel (tools); leather, copper, iron, bronite, rosium, steel (gear, in this order).

_notes.STACK_MAX: the most of one thing a slot holds (tools, armor, packs and belts: always 1)
_notes.SMELT_TIME: seconds a Kiln or Foundry takes to smelt one thing
_notes.BURN_TIMES: how long a torch stays lit, then smoldering, in seconds: [shortest, longest] each, picked at random between them
_notes.FARM: Grain and soil: stageTime seconds a growth stage takes on average (on wet soil), in stageHits lucky ticks; growth is times dryRate on dry soil and times fertRate on fertilized soil; water wets tilled soil joined to it within wetReach blocks; fertilizer lasts fertHarvests ripe harvests; dry tilled soil with nothing growing turns back into Dirt after revertTime seconds; seedChance: the chance tilling grass turns up a Grain Seed
_notes.CROPS: the crops besides Grain (blocks.json CROPS), each with the FARM numbers (stageHits, dryRate, fertRate, wetReach, fertHarvests, revertTime) and its own: stageTime = seconds a stage takes on average on wet soil (a crop has 4 stages: 3 to grow); dryRate (if given) = its own growth on dry soil, in place of FARM's; harvest = [[thing, fewest, most], ...] a ripe one gives when broken (cantaloupe: a Cantaloupe block broken); melonTime = seconds on average between a grown Cantaloupe Vine's melons (in stageHits lucky ticks, at its soil's rate; one melon at a time, on a free side)
_notes.SAPLING: Saplings: leaves broken without a hoe drop their sapling dropChance of the time; a sapling grows into its tree after growTime seconds on average, in growHits lucky ticks (with no room it waits for its next lucky tick); one Bone Ash on a sapling grows it at once boneAshChance of the time
_notes.DURABILITY: uses each tool takes, by what it's made of
_notes.ARMOR_DURABILITY: hits each armor piece takes, by what it's made of
_notes.ARMOR_SHARE: how much of all damage each piece takes off when new: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots (a full set: half)
_notes.PICK_TIER: how good each pickaxe is (an ore needs its tier or better)
_notes.STRATA_PICKAXE: the deepest layer of stone each pickaxe can mine
_notes.PICK_STAGES: stage breaking: stages of Stone or ore each pickaxe swing breaks
_notes.AXE_STAGES: stage breaking: stages of a log each swing breaks, by the axe's material (none: by hand or another tool)
_notes.LOG_STAGES: stage breaking: stages in a log
_notes.STONE_STAGES: stage breaking: stages in Stone, ores, Sandstone and Terracotta, for each layer down
